name: Ontario Mills
summary: Indoor outlet mall with over 200 stores as well as a food court,  movie theatres & comedy club.
description: Ontario Mills is a premier indoor outlet shopping destination in Southern California featuring over 200 brand-name outlet stores offering exceptional value on top brands. As one of the largest outlet malls in California, this expansive shopping center combines factory outlet shopping with entertainment options including dining and entertainment venues.
demographics: Ontario Mills attracts value-conscious shoppers primarily from the Inland Empire region, including families and middle-income households seeking brand-name merchandise at outlet prices. The trade area draws heavily from Ontario, Rancho Cucamonga, and surrounding San Bernardino and Riverside County communities, with a diverse demographic mix reflecting the multicultural population of the Inland Empire. Visitors typically include bargain hunters aged 25-54, families with children looking for deals on clothing and household goods, and tourists traveling along the I-10 corridor who prioritize value and variety in their shopping experience.
